payload.claim: The acceptance criterion for `run_regate` requires that a held lock prints 'one `regate:` line naming the holder's pid and the text the holder wrote,' but `test_regate_declines_a_spec_id_another_process_holds_before_any_runtime_call` in tests/test_spec_id_lock_callers.py never captures stdout (no `capsys` fixture, no print spy) for any of its three cases. It only asserts the return value and that no downstream calls were made. Replacing `print(f"regate: {held}")` with a generic message that drops the pid and holder text, e.g. `print("regate: locked")`, would keep every assertion in this test green while silently breaking the exact behaviour the criterion claims is tested.
